component.name: Keyframe
component.summary: Animate titles, graphics and effects, and composite video

description.p: Keyframe is for motion graphics and compositing: titles, infographics, interface animations and effects on video. You work with compositions and layers animated by keyframes, and export to video, image sequences or Lottie.

ul.li: Compositions, precompositions, solids, nulls, adjustment, shape, text, footage, camera and light layers
Keyframes on every property with linear, Bezier and hold interpolation, a graph editor and motion paths
Masks with variable feather, track mattes, blending modes and motion blur
Shape operators, text animators, effects, expressions and scripting
Motion tracking, stabilization, planar and camera tracking, 2.5D layers
Render queue for video, image sequences with alpha and Lottie, and live compositions in Montage
